title: Sprint 8 - Subqueries, CTEs & Optimization
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Average Priority
tickets.description: Calculate the average priority of all pending tasks.
tasks: Calculate the average priority of all pending tasks.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE status = 'pending';

solution.query.sql: SELECT AVG(priority) FROM todos WHERE status = 'pending';

tickets.title: Task Urgency Levels
tickets.description: Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'.
tasks: Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE CASE WHEN priority = 1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END = 'Normal';

solution.query.sql:
SELECT title, 
  CASE 
    WHEN priority = 1 THEN 'High' 
    ELSE 'Normal' 
  END AS urgency 
FROM todos;
